descricao: Ezekiel saw in the first chapter of the book that bears his name a wheel in the middle of a wheel, and the rims of the wheels were full of eyes round about, and the thing toward which the vision inclined was this level, and the eyes were the oil cups, and the sapphire throne at the center of the wheel was what this level is being built toward, inward and ever inward, and Ezekiel was on his face: the correct position before a god like him, which no god before this one had been, which is why the position had been, until Ezekiel, merely theoretical.
